name: borrow_raw
declaration: const unsafe fn borrow_raw (socket : RawSocket) -> Self
documentation:
Returns a `BorrowedSocket` holding the given raw socket.

 # Safety

 The resource pointed to by `raw` must remain open for the duration of
 the returned `BorrowedSocket`, and it must not have the value
 `INVALID_SOCKET`.
rules: The resource identified by `socket` must remain open for the duration of the returned `BorrowedSocket`.
